get.description: Read a page of CRM objects of a specified type. You can control the data returned by specifying which properties to include in the response. This endpoint supports pagination and allows you to retrieve associated object IDs and archived records.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the `paging.next.after` JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored. Usage of this parameter will reduce the maximum number of objects that can be read by a single request.

post.description: Create a CRM object with the specified properties and receive a copy of the object, including its ID. This endpoint is useful for adding new objects to your CRM system and customizing them with specific properties.

Location.description: URL of the newly created resource

post.description: Archive a batch of CRM objects identified by their IDs. This operation is useful for managing large sets of objects that need to be archived simultaneously, streamlining data management processes.

Create a batch of CRM objects of a specified type in HubSpot. This endpoint allows for the creation of multiple objects in a single request, making it efficient for bulk operations. The response includes a copy of each created object, including their IDs. This is useful for initializing large sets of data or integrating external data sources with HubSpot.

Retrieve a batch of CRM objects by their internal IDs or unique property values. This endpoint is useful for fetching multiple objects in a single request, allowing for efficient data retrieval. You can specify whether to include archived objects in the results.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

post.description: Update a batch of CRM objects in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify multiple objects simultaneously by providing their details in the request body. It is useful for efficiently updating large sets of data, ensuring that all specified objects are updated in a single operation.

Create or update a batch of CRM objects by unique property values. This endpoint allows you to efficiently manage multiple objects in a single request, ensuring that existing objects are updated and new objects are created as needed.

Search for CRM objects of a specified type using various criteria. This endpoint allows you to filter and sort objects based on their properties, enabling efficient retrieval of relevant data. It is useful for finding specific records or analyzing data trends within your CRM.

get.description: Read an object identified by `objectId`. By default, `objectId` refers to the internal object ID, but it can also refer to any unique property value specified by the `idProperty` query parameter. You can control the response content using the `properties` query parameter to specify which properties to include.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived.

parameters.name: associations
parameters.description: A comma separated list of object types to retrieve associated IDs for. If any of the specified associations do not exist, they will be ignored.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned in the response. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

parameters.name: propertiesWithHistory
parameters.description: A comma separated list of the properties to be returned along with their history of previous values. If any of the specified properties are not present on the requested object(s), they will be ignored.

delete.description: Move an Object identified by `{objectId}` to the recycling bin. This operation allows you to archive a specific CRM object by its unique identifier, effectively removing it from active use while retaining it in the system for potential recovery or reference.

patch.description: Perform a partial update of an object identified by `{objectId}`. By default, `{objectId}` refers to the internal object ID, but it can also refer to any unique property value specified by the `idProperty` query parameter. The provided property values will overwrite existing ones. Read-only and non-existent properties will be ignored. To clear a property's value, pass an empty string.

parameters.name: idProperty
parameters.description: The name of a property whose values are unique for this object type

post.description: Permanently delete a contact and all associated content in compliance with GDPR regulations. This endpoint allows you to specify the contact by email using the optional 'idProperty' set to 'email'. If the email address is not found, it will be added to a blocklist to prevent future use.

Merge two CRM objects of the same type in your HubSpot account. This operation combines the properties of the specified objects, resulting in a single object with merged data. Use this endpoint to consolidate duplicate records or unify related data under a single object.

get.description: List all associations of an object by object type. This endpoint allows you to retrieve associations for a specified object, identified by its type and ID, and target object type. The maximum number of associations that can be retrieved per call is 500.

parameters.description: The maximum number of results to display per page.
